title: CoTECH for single-cell joint detection of transcriptome and chromatin occupancy
protocol: Harvest cells from tissues or cultured cell line.
Digest cells into single-cell suspension.
Wash and resuspend cells in PBS or 1% BSA/PBS.
Fix cells by adding -20°C methanol drop by drop to a final concentration of 90%.
Store prepared sample at -80°C for later use.
Wash Concanavalin A (ConA) beads with Binding Buffer twice.
Resuspend activated ConA beads in Binding Buffer before applying them to the cell mixture.
Centrifuge cells at 1000 G, 4°C for 5 min.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml Wash Buffer and add 5~20 µl of activated ConA beads to the suspension.
Incubate the cells-beads mixture at room temperature for 10-20 min.
Collect cells by magnetic stand.
Wash cells with 1 ml Wash Buffer once, place the tube on the magnetic stand, and remove all liquid.
Resuspend cells in 100 μl Antibody buffer (containing 2 mM EDTA, 0.01% Digitonin, 0.05% TX-100, 2% proteinase inhibitor cocktail, 1% recombinant RNase inhibitor).
Add 0.5 μl antibody against the protein of interest.
Incubate the cell suspension at 4°C for approximately 3 hours.
Wash cells twice with 180 µl Dig-Wash Buffer without TX-100 (containing 0.01% Digitonin).
Resuspend cells in 500 μl 1% BSA / PBS.
Prepare PAT incubation plate: Add 70 µl Dig-Wash buffer to each well containing individual combinatorial barcoded PAT-T5 and PAT-T7 at 6 µg/ml.

Dilute 37.5 µM stocked barcoded PAT by Dig Wash Buffer (containing 0.01% Digitonin, 0.05% TX-100, 2% proteinase inhibitor cocktail, 1% recombinant RNase inhibitor, and 1 mM DTT) at a ratio of 1:445 to reach a final concentration of 6 µg/ml.
Add 35 µl diluted PAT-T5 and 35 µl diluted PAT-T7 to each well.
FACS or pipette 500-2,000 cells into each well.
Place the plate on a rotator and incubate at 4°C for 1 h.
Put the plate on a 96-well magnetic stand and pull off all liquid.
Wash cells twice with 180 μl Dig-Wash buffer (Wash Buffer supplemented with 0.01% Digitonin and 0.05% TX-100).
Resuspend cells with 10 µl cold Reaction Buffer by pipetting.
Incubate the plate at 25°C for 1 h in a thermal cycler; gently mix once after 30 min.
Add 10 μl 40 mM EDTA to each well and mix well.
Incubate the plate at 4°C for 15 min.
Add 1 µl 250 mM MgCl₂ to each well and incubate the plate at 4°C for 5 min.
Collect cells by magnetic stand.
Briefly wash cells with 100 μl 1% BSA/PBS and discard all liquid.
Add 2 µl barcoded RT-lysis Buffer (1.2 µl PBS, 0.5 µl 10 mM dNTP mix, 0.05 µl RNase inhibitor (Takara), 0.25 µl 5 µM barcoded oligo dT, and 0.01% Digitonin) to each well.
Incubate the plate at 55°C for 5 min and immediately put the plate onto a cold block to cool down.

Add 2.85 µl RT-mix (0.20 µl SuperScript IV reverse transcriptase (Thermo Fisher), 0.125 µl RNase inhibitor (Takara), 1 µl 5 x SuperScript IV first-strand buffer (Thermo Fisher), 0.25 µl 100 mM DTT, 1 µl 5M Betaine (Sigma), 0.05 µl 100 µM TSO (Table S1) and 0.195 µl PBS, 0.03 µl 1M MgCl2, and 0.01% Digitonin) to each well.
Perform reverse transcription as below: 4°C 2 min, 10°C 2 min, 20°C 2 min, 30°C 2 min, 42°C 10 min, 50°C 2 min, 55°C 5 min, and hold at 4°C.
Add 5 µl cold Sorting Buffer (PBS supplemented with 2% BSA and 2 mM EDTA) to each well.
Combine all cells from 96 wells into a 1.5 ml tube.
Wash cells with 1 ml 1% BSA/PBS.
Add DAPI(Thermo) to a final concentration of 1
Filter cells through a 70 µm cell strainer to remove clumps.
Sort 20-25 cells into each well of a new 96-well plate containing 3 µl Lysis Buffer in each well.
Incubate the plate at 55°C for 60 min.
Add 1 µl of 1.8% Triton X-100 and 1 µl of 10 mM PMSF to each well.
Incubate the plate at 55°C for 5 min.
Add 20 µl PCR mix (components as specified) to each well.
Perform PCR enrichment according to the protocol: initial denaturation, denaturing, annealing, and extension cycles followed by a final extension cycle and hold at 4°C.
Immediately add 0.5 µl of total 10 µM connector A/B primer mix to each well after PCR mix addition.
Incubate with further PCR cycles as specified in the protocol.
Pipette 100 µl original AMPure XP beads into a new tube.
Put the tube on magnetic stand and resuspend beads in 1000 µl AMPure binding buffer.
Add 20 µl custom diluted AMPure XP beads to each well.
Vortex thoroughly.
Transfer 5 μl DNA elution to a new plate for DNA-partition library preparation.
Transfer another 5 μl DNA elution to a new plate for RNA-partition library preparation.
Add 15 µl PCR mix (including KAPA HiFi DNA Polymerase, buffer, dNTPs, MgCl₂, and primer mix) to each well.
Perform PCR enrichment: 95°C for 3 min; 8 cycles of 98°C for 20 s, 65°C for 30 s, 72°C for 1 min; 72°C for 5 min; hold at 4°C.
Add 2 µl 1:8 diluted ExoI to each well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 60 min followed by 72°C for 20 min.
Mix 0.6 μl ddH₂O, 1 μl 10 mM Truseq index i5, and 1 μl Truseq index i7 to each well.
Perform PCR enrichment with 1 cycle of 95°C for 3 minutes; followed by 5 cycles of 98°C for 20 seconds, 65°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 1 minute; then 1 cycle of 72°C for 5 minutes; hold at 4°C.
Combine all PCR products into a 50 ml tube.
Purify DNA using TIANquick Mini Purification Kit and elute in 60 μl ddH₂O.
Purify the library once with 0.8X AMPure XP beads.
Perform gel extraction for fragments at sizes of 400-1,000 bp on a 1.5% agarose gel.
Purify DNA using 0.8 × AMPure XP beads and elute with 20 μl ddH₂O.
Sequence the libraries with paired-end 150-bp reads on Novaseq 6000 platform (Illumina).
Add 2.5 µl tagmentation mix to each well, including 0.75 µl 10X TAPS-MgCl₂, 0.75 µl DMF, and 1 µl Tn5-MEA.
Incubate the plate at 55°C for 5 minutes in a thermal cycler.
Add 1 μl 0.2% SDS to each well and incubate at 55°C for 5 minutes.
Add 1 μl 1.8% TX-100 to each well to quench SDS, then incubate at 55°C for 5 minutes.
Add 0.8 µl KAPA HiFi DNA Polymerase to each well.
Add 8 µl 5 x KAPA High-GC Buffer to each well.
Add 1 µl 10 mM dNTP Mix to each well.
Add 0.8 µl 25 mM MgCl₂ to each well.
Add 17.9 µl H₂O to each well.
Add 1 µl 10 mM Nextera index i5 primer to each well.
Add 1 µl Truseq index i7 primer to each well.
Perform PCR enrichment with 1 cycle of 72°C for 5 min.
Continue PCR enrichment with 1 cycle of 95°C for 3 min.
Proceed with PCR enrichment for 11 cycles: 98°C for 20 s, 65°C for 30 s, and 72°C for 1 min each cycle.
Complete PCR enrichment with 1 cycle of 72°C for 5 min.
Hold the reaction at 4°C after PCR enrichment.
Combine all PCR products into a 50 ml tube.
Purify DNA using TIANquick Mini Purification Kit; elute in 60 µl ddH₂O.
Purify the library once with 0.8X (48 µl) AMPure XP beads.
Perform gel extraction for fragments of size 400-1,000 bp on a 1.5% agarose gel.
Purify DNA using 0.8 × AMPure XP beads; elute with 20 µl ddH₂O.
Sequence the libraries with paired-end 150-bp reads on Novaseq 6000 platform (Illumina).
